# DU PYQ Online

> DU PYQ Online (https://www.dupyq.online) is a free archive of 29,000+ University of Delhi (DU) previous year question papers across 118 undergraduate programmes, organised by course and subject. Every paper links to its original PDF. No login is required.

## Previous year question papers
- [All DU previous year papers](https://www.dupyq.online/previous-year-papers): every DU programme with its paper count, linking to course pages
- [Papers browser](https://www.dupyq.online/papers): pick a course, then a subject, to view papers
- Course pages: https://www.dupyq.online/papers/{course-slug}, e.g. [B.Com (Hons)](https://www.dupyq.online/papers/bcom-hons): every subject in the course
- Subject pages: https://www.dupyq.online/papers/{course-slug}/{subject-slug}: every available paper for that subject, grouped by exam year, with paper code (UPC) and paper type

## Other resources
- [Notes](https://www.dupyq.online/notes): subject notes
- [Syllabus](https://www.dupyq.online/syllabus)
- [Blog](https://www.dupyq.online/blog): DU exam guides
- [Sitemap](https://www.dupyq.online/sitemap.xml)
